svg.text: Cut 440 x 300 mm from 3 mm aluminium; round the corners 10 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 9 mm holes on the centre line, 60 from the top and bottom edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print the instructions in the camp languages with pictograms:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: leave first, raise the alarm, fetch the cart, small fires only,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: never water on oil or live wires, call the fire service.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: on the front face of the back right post, bottom edge 1,100

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: above the ground, two M8 bolts through the post.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: readable from 5 m in daylight.
